summary: Quaffing an uncursed sickness potion reaches potion.c:peffect_sickness. JavaScript throws before completing the effect because it calls the already-ported attrib.c:poisontell without its required message operation; the following adjattrib call also omits that operation. Port the whole sickness effect and pass the source-ordered caller environment so C messages, attribute loss, hit-point loss, RNG, and hallucination cleanup can complete.

source.branch: For a non-Healer quaffing an unblessed sickness potion without Fixed_abil, potion.c:peffect_sickness calls poisontell then adjattrib after rn2(A_MAX); poison resistance determines the attribute decrement and damage branch. The C function also covers blessed, Healer, Fixed_abil, sink, and hallucination paths.
callers: potion.c:peffects POT_SICKNESS dispatches peffect_sickness from dopotion/dodrink; js/potion.js:peffects calls its local peffect_sickness after the quaff command.
dependencies: attrib.c:poisontell and adjattrib are already ported; provide their message and encumbrance operations instead of weakening their contracts.
The effect invokes losehp, exercise, and make_hallucinated in source order; inspect their current ported caller contracts and note only discarded void gaps.

evidence: Saved v9 baseline challenges/evaluations/20260927170744-v9.json records error "attribute upkeep requires message" and 0/33 screens for the immutable C recording.

Fresh scan at combined main 2e0a01a106aa02ff3ae520093dd4712eabe6fb6d confirms TypeError from attrib.js:requiredOperation called by poisontell at js/potion.js:peffect_sickness, then potion quaff dispatch.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/potion.c:peffect_sickness lines 964-1021 calls poisontell and adjattrib after selecting typ; js/potion.js currently invokes both without the required environment. The full function has additional resistance, role, blessed, sink, and hallucination branches.
